visitor_job: Choose RED Night or RISE Night and know exactly when to attend.
entry_condition: Direct route or main-menu arrival; this may be the first page a visitor sees.
critical_answer: College and early-career community. RED Night meets on the third Saturday at 7 PM; RISE Night meets on the second and fourth Thursdays at 7:30 PM. Both use the Youth Center.
supporting_proof: Actual source copy and authentic source assets; consult the asset manifest.
objections_answered: Who is this for, when and where does it happen, and what happens after the action?
secondary_path: The main menu and genuine church contact channels. Marketing routes remain inside the redesign.

signature.structural_idea: Two distinct event editions with intact poster objects and adjacent schedules

heading_arrival.evidence: Keep text readable rather than invent fifteen source heading animations. The strict pairwise two-axis gate remains unresolved; do not randomize effects to pass.

implementation.values: Bounded 18px / opacity .75 image entry over 700ms, or 2px clarity entry over 650ms. Reconstruction estimates; source editor values unavailable. Once-entry; normal reverse scroll. No pinning.
implementation.deviation: Motion is estimated rather than exact editor reconstruction. No invented pairwise axis distinctions. Every element remains visible before script.
deleted: Legacy texture-only source backgrounds omitted where they conflicted with the locked identity; asset files retained.
No automatic decorative arrows or icon badges.

functional_checks.result: 24 browser checks clean: no overflow, required ledger omissions, missing loaded images, JS errors, or hidden reduced-motion essentials; menu/Escape functional.

motion_contract.reason: Event art and dates hold; RED and RISE explanatory passages enter when individually reached, then wider congregation photograph. Later scripture clarity reverses.
motion_contract.reverse: Timed first-entry does not replay; declared focus recomputes on scroll and reverses. Native content remains visible.
motion_contract.mobile: No mobile pin added; same semantic order in native flow.
motion_contract.limitations: These are restrained source-mechanism adaptations, not unique arbitrary heading axes. Exact Framer editor timings unavailable.
